fault_mode: A misspelled Cython WR destructor prevents SGE buffers from being released during garbage collection.
trigger: Repeatedly create and discard work requests carrying SGE buffers, allowing garbage collection to run between batches.
observation: Process memory or registered-buffer usage rises over repeated create/destroy cycles rather than stabilizing.
recovery: After references are released and collection completes, resource use must return near baseline and new work requests remain allocatable.
